message.content:
An editorial magazine cover features a portrait of a person’s face, stylized as an illustration. The person has short dark hair and wears black-rimmed glasses. The right side of their face is rendered with realistic skin tones, while the left side transforms into a vertical stack of grey architectural and industrial structures. These structures include building facades with numerous windows, cranes, and what appears to be an offshore platform or complex machinery. The combined figure is centered against a dark blue background.

At the top, white text reads "PILIHAN POLITIK TEMAN PRESIDEN". Below it, the large red title "TEMPO" is set in a serif font. Smaller red text underneath reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". In the bottom right corner, large white text reads "SETELAH DIA KEMBALI". The In the bottom left, white text includes "1-7 AGUSTUS 2016", "RP 39.500", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN". A barcode with the numbers "9 770126 427302" and "00023" is at the base. A small yellow and red "TEMPO 45" logo is in the upper left. The entire composition is framed by a thin red border on the left and bottom.
